static_traits.name: Chen Ran
static_traits.social_status: 有几位亲密朋友,但通常not与他们讨论自己容易放弃的感受;倾向回避与朋友的竞争情境
static_traits.medical_history: without心理治疗史;No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Positive attitude,愿意改变;在谈及失败时use绝对化表述(如'我永远not会...');倾向关注负面并以回避作为主要应对

basic_info.main_problem: 我容易在失败后轻易放弃,最近在视频游戏段位赛失利后觉得自己永远not会再玩,这一模式近期加重并导致我回避游戏和其他竞争情境.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize that this pattern of readily giving up after failure is negatively affecting my enjoyment of video games and the guitar, so I am seeking counseling.
growth_experiences: 长期以来在学业与游戏等竞争情境中,失败后常以彻底回避作为主要应对(停止参与活动),not yet曾接受心理治疗;一直对自己抱有较高期待,最初压力中等,近来逐渐加重并扩展到Work与日常兴趣(如烹饪,弹吉他).
在Work中虽然总体表现Good,但因害怕失败而倾向回避具有挑战性的项目,这一倾向在过去已有反复经历,并影响到与朋友的竞争互动.

special_situations.event: The most recent ranked match loss in a video game
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我失败,就说明I am not good enough,继续玩也have not意义
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately stops the game and avoids participating in ranked matches again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远not会再玩这个游戏了/I will not succeed

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能确保成功,就not应该尝试;失败会证明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding participation or pushing away challenging projects
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我大概率会失败,最好not要做

special_situations.event: Being in competitive activities or settings with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表现not如他人,就等于失败,会让我难堪
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to avoid competitive activities with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们,参与只会更糟

special_situations.event: Encountering setbacks when trying to cook new dishes or practice guitar
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次做not好就说明我这方面not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stops trying new dishes or reduces practice
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次not做好,证明我not擅长,还是do not继续了

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized in competition and challenges and to prove own worth
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败导致自我价值被negate,引发强烈的挫败与压力
defense_goal: Maintains the stability of self-esteem and emotions by avoiding competition and challenges

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的失败者(一旦失败就全盘negate自己)
object_relations.object_representation: Picky and judgmental others or competitors (who might embarrass me)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked to review failures or invited to try challenging tasks (for example discussing 'recent failures' or 'doing small experiments' in counseling)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将一次失败视为永久失败的证据,认为继续尝试只会证明自己'not行'(移情:将他人期待体验为评判)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use温和,not评判的语气,承认其感受,提示灰度与连续谱;通过开放式QuestioningGuidance其发现部分成功与Learning点,避免绝对化词语.

manifestations: In interests such as video games, guitar, and cooking, easily gives up due to failure, subjective enjoyment significantly declines
Avoiding competition narrows life experiences, making it hard to gain satisfaction from activities
因害怕失败而缩减选择与行动Freedom,倾向只做可确保成功的事
Interprets one failure as a permanent limitation, losing the sense of self-direction

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 频繁以绝对化语言评价自己(如'I am not good enough''I will never succeed')
Finds it hard to recall successful experiences; mainly focuses on failures
Before competitive situations, excessive self-scrutiny leads to choosing avoidance

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: 面对挑战或竞争的冲动时选择把能量转为自我Withdrawal与停止行动(如停止游戏,避开项目)
倾向not向朋友表达或寻求支持,而是独自消化并撤退

positive_force: Work表现总体Good,具备稳定的职业功能
拥Has a few friends to talk with (potential support resources)
愿意改变,Positive attitude,愿意尝试识do not并重构自动化思维
能够识do not自身问题模式(觉察到'失败后轻易放弃')
negative_force: 对失败的高度Fear与全或without思维
Mental filtering, pays more attention to negative experiences, difficult to recall successes
Avoidance as the main coping strategy limits attempts and growth

target_behavior.behavior: 在经历失败或Anticipation失败后立即放弃并回避竞争/挑战性活动
antecedent: Losing in a ranked video game match
Being in a competitive scenario with friends
Encounters setbacks when trying new dishes or practicing guitar
target_behavior.core_reason: 对失败的灾难化和全或without认知(一次失败即等于永久失败/not够好),加之长期高期待与自我价值与成败过度捆绑
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败带来的Anxiety与Self-denial,以短期缓解压力
target_behavior.consequence: Declining interest and fun,skillLearning与发展受阻,Career development受限,Reduced social interaction与回避
